data.name: Zeeshan Ali
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Zeeshan Ali has made a big mark in cricket. With 4 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 39*, with an average of 43.00 and a quick strike rate of 209.76. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 8 sixes and 4 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 4.0 overs, taking 5 wickets at an economy rate of 14.00. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
